@@ Attunement
@stat: Pr
@description:
  Descriptions This skill enables a character to use the spell abilities of
  wand, or any item with spell casting abilities. In order spells from an
  item, the wielder of the item must have made Attunement static maneuver. If
  an item has several spells or groups of spells that are separated in power
  or type, the GM may require separate Attunement (staves & wands) static
  maneuvers for each group of spells. “Teaching” someone else an item is not
  permitted because using an item is a personal experience between the
  individual the item. Although you may tell someone what the item does thus
  remove any penalty for not knowing the spell(s) in the you cannot aid them.
  Certain spells on items do not normally require Attunement rolls, subject
  to GM stipulation. They clude: 1) Spells that operate constantly: Boots of
  Silence, Cloaks Invisibility, etc. 2) Bonuses built into items: Bonuses on
  weapons, bonuses armor, spell adders, spell multipliers, etc. 3) Spells in
  intelligent items: Intelligent items can cast the that they contain when
  instructed by a wielder who can communicate with the item and whom the item
  will obey specifically created otherwise, intelligent items will obey
  wielder). All of these cases include spells that do not require conscious
  casting of any spell by the wielder of the item. character should be given
  one chance to Attune to an item. fails, he may not try again until he
  improves his skill rank Attunement.  Character does not know the realm of
  the spell ..........................-20 Character knows the realm of the
  spell ......................................+10 Character does not know
  what spell is ........................................-10 Character knows
  what spell is....................................................+20
  Character’s realm differs from
  spell’s.........................................-30 Character can cast

@@ Power Perception
@stat: Pr
@description:
  A If he This skill provides a bonus for seeing active Essence (blue), with
  Channeling (red) and Mentalism (green) magic. If the GM allows players to
  develop the skill of Power Perception he should stipulate that Detect Magic
  spells will detect Magic, active inactive (e.g., waiting spells).

@@ Read Runes
@stat: Me
@description:
  Rune skill enables a character to decipher and use Runes (spells inscribed
  in suitable media). If the level of the spell on Rune is less than or equal
  to the level of the character attempting to use it to cast a spell,
  deciphering the Rune is sufficient to it (subject to the normal chances of
  spell failure). If the Rune level above the character, or of a realm of
  magic other than specialty, a second roll, similar to the first, must be
  made successfully cast the spell from the Rune. Runes are generally
  reusable, but the rune paper is. A character should be given one chance to
  decipher a Rune. he fails, he may not try again until he improves his skill
  rank with Read Runes.  Character does not know the realm of the spell
  ..........................-20 Character knows the realm of the spell
  ......................................+10 Character does not know what
  spell is ........................................-10 Character knows what
  spell is....................................................+20 Character’s
  realm differs from spell’s.........................................-30
  Character can cast spell
  intrinsically..........................................+30

-26 down | Spectacular Failure | -100% | 2.0u | -30 | Your carelessness earns misfortune. You stare into the source of magic, and it blinds you as a gaze into the sun. Your inner eye (and thus all skills in this category) is at a -30 modification for the next month. You probably don’t look both ways when crossing the street, do you? The spell, if any, goes off.
-25 — 04 | Absolute Failure | -20% | 1.5u | -10 | Great Jumpin’ Lizards! Your attempt to tune your senses to mystical forces yields a power backlash! Roll on the NonAttack • Other Spell category of the Spell Failure Table in Spell Law (6.6, p. 224). The spell, if any, goes off.
05 — 75 | Failure | 0% | 1.25u | -5 | The forces you seek elude you. Perhaps a period of meditation would clear your mind for another attempt. Then again, you may be beyond hope.
UM 66 | Unusual Event | 130% | 3.0u | +30 | You merge your senses with your target, and dip into a brief flash of psychometry. You glimpse a series of visions, scenes and significant events associated with the target’s past. The visions last for 3 rounds, during which time you are in an unwakeable trance. When you emerge from the trance, you will have a great deal of information about the target, as well as being Attuned to it (if appropriate). Note that artifacts may receive RRs to this effect.
76 — 90 | Partial Success | 20% | 1.25u | +0 | You see what you are after, but it is meaningless to you. Your frame of reference is inappropriate to this venue. You may try again only after resting for 1 hour. [The realm of the spell (if any), is known.]
UM 100 | Unusual Success |  |  |  | With a mental wrench, you pull yourself into a higher plane of perception. Here, magical energies flow before you like bright threads and currents, brilliant in hue and of endless variety of form. You may, for the next 5 rounds, view and track such flows, as well as use them to your advantage. During this time you receive a +15 to all spell casting attempts, as well as being able to Attune yourself to any object which you can touch for a full round and concentrate. In addition, you may identify forms of magic (q.v. Power Perception). Whoa. [The spell (if any), is known and usable.]
91 — 110 | Near Success | 80% | 1.25u | +10 | Despite your best efforts, things remain just out of focus. Another attempt, if appropriate, may be made at +10 to clarify matters. [The spell (if any), is known.]
111 — 175 | Success | 100% | 1.0u | +20 | Your mystical senses are at your beck. Your maneuver succeeds normally. [The spell (if any), is known and usable.]
176 up | Absolute Success | 120% | .75u | +30 | You slip into the realm of the magical with effortless grace, discerning all you seek and more. You stare beyond the superficial into the workings of the forces you examine. Of course, this may be more than you wanted to know…be careful what you ask for, as you may get it! [The spell (if any), is known and usable.].
